name: abixell-one
description: Abixell One - Enterprise Core Foundation (Phase 0). Internal positioning: Whitelabel Integrated Enterprise Management System. Client-facing term 'whitelabel' must never appear in this codebase's user-facing strings.

scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/api && npm run lint -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.validate: npm run validate:platform-boundaries && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test -w apps/api && npm run build && npm run validate:pwa && npm run validate:security
